Seit über 50 Jahren produzieren und vertreiben wir die beliebten flexi® Roll-Leinen. Wir beschäftigen ca. 300 Mitarbeiter und sind als Weltmarktführer und „Hidden Champion“ zu einer „Marke des Jahrhunderts“ geworden. Unser weltbekanntes Produkt liefern wir heute in mehr als 90 Länder.
  
  
Für unseren Unternehmensstandort in Bargteheide bei Hamburg suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt einen engagierte/n

**Softwareentwickler (m/w/d)**
==============================

### **.NET / C# / KI-Anwendungen**

**Gestalten Sie die digitale Zukunft unseres Unternehmens mit!**

Sie möchten nicht nur Code schreiben, sondern aktiv Prozesse verbessern, neue Ideen einbringen und moderne Technologien einsetzen? Dann werden Sie Teil unseres Teams.

Als Softwareentwickler (m/w/d) arbeiten Sie an der Weiterentwicklung unserer zentralen Unternehmensanwendungen und unterstützen die digitale Transformation unseres Unternehmens. Dabei kombinieren Sie klassische Softwareentwicklung mit modernen Technologien wie Künstlicher Intelligenz, Automatisierung und datengetriebenen Lösungen.

**Wichtig:**
  
Diese Position ist als Präsenzstelle an unserem Standort in Bargteheide vorgesehen.
  
Homeoffice ist aktuell nicht möglich.

**Ihre Aufgaben:**

* Weiterentwicklung und Optimierung unserer Softwarelösungen auf Basis von .NET und C#
* Ausbau und Anpassung unseres ERP-Systems (Sage Office Line) in enger Zusammenarbeit mit den Fachbereichen
* Entwicklung von Schnittstellen und Datenintegrationen zwischen ERP-, Datenbank- und Drittsystemen
* Analyse, Konzeption und Umsetzung neuer digitaler Geschäftsprozesse
* Einsatz von KI-gestützten Lösungen zur Automatisierung von Abläufen, Auswertungen und internen Prozessen
* Erstellung von Reports, Dashboards und Auswertungen auf Basis von SQL-Datenbanken
* Analyse, Fehlerbehebung und kontinuierliche Verbesserung bestehender Anwendungen
* Mitarbeit in spannenden IT- und Digitalisierungsprojekten von der Idee bis zur Umsetzung
  

**Ihr Profil:**

* Ausbildung als Fachinformatiker für Anwendungsentwicklung (m/w/d), Informatikstudium oder vergleichbare Qualifikation
* Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung mit .NET und C#
* Gute Kenntnisse in MS SQL Server sowie im Umgang mit relationalen Datenbanken
* Erfahrung mit Visual Studio und idealerweise VBA
* Verständnis für Softwarearchitekturen, Datenmodelle und Geschäftsprozesse
* Interesse an modernen Technologien, Automatisierung und Künstlicher Intelligenz
* Selbstständige, strukturierte Arbeitsweise und Freude an der Zusammenarbeit mit verschiedenen Fachbereichen
* Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
  

**Das bieten wir Ihnen:**

* Viel Gestaltungsspielraum und die Möglichkeit, eigene Ideen einzubringen
* Direkter Einfluss auf die Digitalisierung und Weiterentwicklung des Unternehmens
* Spannende Projekte rund um ERP, Datenmanagement, Automatisierung und KI
* Kurze Entscheidungswege und flache Hierarchien in einem inhabergeführten Familienunternehmen
* Ein kleines, kollegiales Team mit offener Kommunikation
* Moderne Arbeitsmittel und die Möglichkeit, neue Technologien aktiv mitzugestalten
* Hundefreundlicher Arbeitsplatz
* 30 Tage Urlaub

jobs.title: Section Engineer
jobs.description:
**About the role**

**Job Title**: Section Engineer

**Location:** Aberdeen

**Project Type:** Civils / Energy

**Company:** Balfour Beatty Group

Balfour Beatty is a leading national infrastructure and construction company with more than a century of heritage in Scotland, delivering key projects that strengthen communities and improve national connectivity.

The Netherton Hub is a major new energy infrastructure development located near Peterhead in Aberdeenshire, forming a key part of SSEN Transmission’s multi‑billion‑pound **Accelerated Strategic Transmission Investment (ASTI)** programme and its wider **Pathway to 2030** upgrade of the Scottish transmission network.

Designed to strengthen the UK’s ability to transport renewable electricity from the north of Scotland to high‑demand centres nationwide, the hub will incorporate a new High Voltage Direct Current (HVDC) converter station, a 400 kV substation, a 132 kV substation, and associated operational facilities. Once complete, it will enable efficient long‑distance transmission of offshore and onshore renewable energy, supporting both UK and Scottish Government net‑zero targets while delivering significant economic benefits, job creation, and local supply‑chain opportunities.

By joining the ASTI Netherton Hub project, candidates will gain hands‑on experience delivering one of the UK’s most significant energy programmes, developing advanced personal and professional skills, benefiting from long‑term career progression within a national framework, and playing a direct role in strengthening Scotland’s renewable‑powered future

 **What you'll be doing**  

* Taking responsibility for the delivery of defined sections of work across the ASTI **civils package**, ensuring activities are completed safely, to programme, and to the required quality standards
* Supporting the planning, coordination, and execution of **core civils works**, including earthworks, drainage, reinforced concrete structures, ducting, and access infrastructure
* Setting out works and maintaining accurate **engineering control and survey data** in line with project requirements
* Managing and maintaining **QA documentation**, inspection and test plans, and as‑built records
* Assisting with the preparation and implementation of **method statements, risk assessments, and temporary works**
* Coordinating subcontractors and direct labour to ensure efficient and safe site operations
* Working closely with the **Site Agent, Sub Agent, and wider project team** to resolve technical queries and maintain progress
* Monitoring progress against programme and supporting the identification and mitigation of risks and constraints
* Ensuring full compliance with **Balfour Beatty’s health, safety, quality, and environmental standards**
* Contributing to a positive, collaborative site culture aligned with **Balfour Beatty values and behaviours**

 **Who we're looking for**  

* An experienced **Section Engineer** with a strong background in **civil engineering projects** across Scotland
* Proven experience delivering defined sections of work on **infrastructure, energy, highways, or general civils projects**
* Sound technical knowledge across core civils activities including **earthworks, drainage, reinforced concrete, and temporary works**
* Confident in **setting‑out, QA documentation, method statements, and risk assessments**
* Experience coordinating **subcontractors and site teams** to ensure works are delivered safely, on programme, and to specification
* Strong understanding of **health, safety, quality, and environmental requirements** on large construction sites
* Ability to work effectively with **Site Agents, Engineers, and Project Management teams** in a collaborative environment
* Proactive, organised, and capable of managing multiple site priorities
* Familiarity with **Scottish standards and site conditions** is highly desirable
* Relevant **civil engineering qualification** (HNC/HND/Degree or equivalent experience)

 **Why work for us**

**Professional & Personal Development**

The size and scale of Balfour Beatty coupled with our strong pipeline of work provides incredible opportunities, regardless of what stage you are at in your career.

We encourage and empower our employees to take control of their career and explore which part of the business they want to work in and what role is right for them. We actively encourage our managers and employees to have open communication throughout the year about wellbeing, development and career opportunities.

We're also very proud of our Balfour Beatty Academy. Whether it’s sharpening your technical expertise, improving your personal skills or seeking support to become professionally qualified.

* Be part of a major energy infrastructure investment that’s shaping the UK’s low-carbon future.
* Work on challenging, high-profile projects with the support of a skilled, multi-disciplinary team.
* Join a culture of learning, improvement, and excellence—where your voice makes a difference.
* Enjoy a competitive salary and benefits package, development opportunities, and a flexible, inclusive working environment.

**For further information about Balfour Beatty Regional Scotland please go to www.balfourbeatty.com/careers/Scotland - You can also check out further job opportunities in the careers section**

 **About us**

From Dunfermline’s tramways in 1909 to highland hospitals today, Balfour Beatty has been trusted for over a century to deliver the complex and critical infrastructure and iconic buildings Scotland relies on.

We have the people, knowledge and experience to safely deliver projects right first time, maximising value for money and ensuring a positive social impact and inclusive economic growth for local communities.

Our award-winning sustainable projects, including active travel, Passivhaus and retrofit, demonstrate our commitment to supporting Scotland’s transition towards net zero in the built environment.

**Diversity and inclusion**

At Balfour Beatty we believe that diversity and inclusion are essential components of any successful, happy workplace. Through our Value Everyone Diversity and Inclusion Strategy and Action Plan, we are growing our diverse workforce and developing our inclusive culture where everyone is able to thrive and reach their full potential, regardless of their identity or background. To find out how we are making this a reality, visit www.balfourbeatty.com/diversityandinclusion

To help and support us with our desired commitment to create an inclusive culture we are members of WISE, enei, Business Disability Forum and the Association for Black and Minority Ethnic Engineers (AFBE). In 2020, we signed the Audeliss and Involve Open Letter to demonstrate our commitment to taking key long term and sustainable actions on Black Inclusion. Balfour Beatty is also a Gold Award holder in the Ministry of Defence 'Employer Recognition Scheme' and actively encourage applications from Armed Forces personnel, veterans and reservists.

As a Disability Confident Employer, we are committed to working with people who have disabilities and long-term health conditions to remove barriers for them in obtaining employment. We are also committed to offering applicants with a disability an interview if they meet the minimum requirements for the role. For more info, visit: https://disabilityconfident.campaign.gov.uk/

We are looking to continually improve our resourcing process and ensure that it is fair and inclusive for all. If you have any feedback on the process, please share this with us at: candidaterecruitmentqueries@balfourbeatty.com
